issues.title: Ranked retrieval results for the local semantic contract

criteria.requirement: success returns an ordered list of scored hits

tests.name: success returns highest score first with deterministic path ties
success rejects empty results and out-of-range or nonfinite scores
retrieval returns a separately immutable ranked snapshot

criteria.requirement: invalid input and not-found paths unchanged

tests.name: blank queries remain invalid and never invoke index
missing matches remain notFound without invented hits
retrieval forwards typed invalid and missing results unchanged

criteria.requirement: contract stays free of embedding model and filesystem dependencies
criteria.reason: Source review confirms a pure synchronous typed boundary with no imports, I/O, embeddings or provider calls; no on-device model or filesystem validation is claimed.

criteria.requirement: Native UI, macOS TCC, VoiceOver/RTL and model integration
criteria.reason: Out of scope for #763; requires actual hardware/runtime integration and real device evidence. Keep #763 and #585 open.
